newsitem.title: USA: Ford to restructure auto-parts unit - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Ford to restructure auto-parts unit - WSJ.

text.p: Ford Motor Co this fall is expected to announce the reorganization of its auto-parts manufacturing operations, a move that could bring the $16.4 billion-a-year unit closer to an eventual spinoff, The Wall Street Journal said.

In Monday's electronic edition, the paper said the move to restructure and rename the unit is part of an eight-month-old effort to make Ford's Automotive Products Operations more competitive for outside business and more profitable.
The article cites people familiar with the plans who say the unit's weaker and unprofitable product lines are being reevaluated for restructuring or sale.
